negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, 3D CGI plastic skin, glossy CGI render, flat 2D digital drawing, vector art, cartoon drawing, real biological human skin, deformed hands, extra fingers, scary insect teeth, grotesque insect mouthparts, oversaturated neon colors, harsh flash glare
reconstruction_priority: tactile scale juxtaposition between tiny handcrafted puppet and giant fluffy bumblebee — AI frequently normalizes scales to standard insect size or renders the bee as a tiny speck
delicate horizontal paintbrush contact connecting the artisan's hand to the bee's face — AI often breaks the brush shaft or misaligns the hand grip
dense tactile synthetic fur texture of the bumblebee and knitted wool loops of the puppet's clothing — AI tends to melt fibers into smooth airbrushed CGI gradients
shallow macro depth of field with razor-sharp plane of focus on the interaction and creamy foliage bokeh — AI often sharpens background leaves indiscriminately
